families.candle_anatomy: Single/multi-candle shapes. NO standalone edge — context features only.
families.statistical: Time-series anomalies (momentum, reversal, drift). Re-validate per market.
families.scheduled: Macro releases, fixings, expiries. Surprise-vs-consensus processing.
families.microstructure: Order flow, absorption, reporting barriers, cascades.

events.mechanism: Price pierces a stop-cluster level (equal highs/lows 4.2x denser), captures trapped orders, then reclaims.
events.machinery: SweepDetector: wick beyond level -> close back inside within N bars.
events.thesis: reject toward the opposite pool
events.invalidation: close beyond the swept level with follow-through
events.conversion: Mean-reversion family; entry on reclaim retest; invalidation stop beyond the wick extreme.

events.mechanism: Break closes back inside the range; breakout traders trapped; 60-80% of naive breaks fail.
events.machinery: FakeoutDetector: close outside then close back inside.
events.thesis: fade toward the opposite edge
events.conversion: Mean-reversion fade; stop at failure extreme; target opposite edge.

events.mechanism: Body-close beyond the level with wide body, low wick on break side, follow-through 2-3 bars.
events.machinery: BreakoutDetector (required: body close outside, gap/pressure, momentum alignment).
events.thesis: continuation toward next pool
events.conversion: Momentum family; entry on retest-hold; trail via integrity break.

events.mechanism: Tight consolidation (range < k*ATR) resolves by expansion; compression precedes runs.
events.machinery: MarketContext RANGE/COIL + EXPANSION; SqueezeDetector (current avg range/ATR vs long window).
events.thesis: on expansion, ride the run in direction of break
events.conversion: Momentum family with expanded ATR trail.

events.mechanism: Impulse candle 'speeds up' then a wide-range wick candle (shooting star / gravestone / hammer / dragonfly) closes back inside - blowoff
events.thesis: reversal of the failed impulse
events.conversion: Mean-reversion family; invalidation stop beyond impulse high/low.

events.mechanism: Single-bar displacement >= k*ATR: old structure broken, volatility regime shifting.
events.thesis: strong continuation odds, but transient overbought
events.conversion: Momentum on break with tight initial trail; scale after retest.

events.mechanism: Price HH (LL) vs oscillator LH (HL): fuel drying, high-probability exhaustion precursor.
events.thesis: reversal candidate only at level/structure confluence
events.invalidation: price extends past the last pivot
events.conversion: Enabled only as a filter with structure event; never standalone.

events.mechanism: Price LH (HL) vs oscillator HH (LL): pullback continuation structure in a live trend.
events.thesis: trend continuation after shallow pullback
events.conversion: Momentum family entry on retest.

events.mechanism: Volatility clustering: quiet begets expansion; compression precedes it.
events.thesis: prepare for expansion, direction unknown
events.invalidation: none (timing unknown) - stand aside until expansion
events.conversion: Puts system into scanning/standby; no positioning on compression alone - avoids wasting opportunity early.

events.mechanism: Time-series momentum (recent winner continues short-to-medium term). Robust across markets.
events.thesis: continuation while structure intact
events.conversion: Momentum family; ATR trail; never add into EXHAUSTION.

events.mechanism: After vertical extension (>= k ATR) price reverts toward value/mean.
events.thesis: partial reversion, fade only at BSL/SSL and with wick rejection
events.conversion: Mean-reversion family, only with confluence; tight invalidation.

events.mechanism: Scheduled release: market prices surprise-vs-consensus slowly (drift), with initial overreaction.
events.machinery: EventCalendarProvider (release schedule + consensus) + MarketState surprise score.
events.thesis: trade drift after the dust settles, not the spike
events.invalidation: missed drift 15 min post - stand aside
events.conversion: Event family; post-event drift with integrity stop.

events.mechanism: Volatility contracts ahead of high-impact releases, then expands violently.
events.thesis: do NOT hold positions into the release
events.conversion: Stand-aside primitive: flatten pre-release (anti-waste, anti-giveback).

events.mechanism: London/NY opens concentrate liquidity and often mark the day's direction; thin sessions (Tokyo lunch, NY-close) spike and retrace.
events.machinery: SessionPhaseProvider (session calendar on trading book) + anatomy at session open.
events.thesis: trade the open impulse with the day's structure; avoid thin-session spikes
events.conversion: Time-of-day family; session gating from Governance; avoids low-liquidity traps.

events.mechanism: WMR London 4pm fix and 5pm EST rollover concentrate order flow; tom-next rolls express carry.
events.thesis: avoid participation during fix spikes; harvest carry-based flows across rollover only if calibrated
events.conversion: Stand-aside + carry harvesting; low-frequency, capital-efficient.

events.mechanism: Leveraged-liquidations push price beyond value then snap back (cascades exhaust counterparty).
events.machinery: MarketState cascade proxy (vertical expansion into liquidity + violent reversal).
events.thesis: fade the cascade tail only after snap-back confirmation
events.conversion: Mean-reversion family with invalidation beyond cascade extreme.

events.mechanism: Options expiry (third Friday) pulls IVOL - pinning and expiry-week distortion; reversal after expiry.
events.thesis: beware pinning; skew trading after pin resolves
events.conversion: Sizing guard / stand-aside near expiry; no new momentum entries into pin.

events.mechanism: Price retraces into the ATR-normalised healthy zone (0.25-0.65 of the impulse; deeper = turning into reversal).
events.machinery: PullbackTracker: impulse leg + normalized depth + structure anchor.
events.thesis: impulse intact - bank what was obtainable, lay up the re-entry
events.invalidation: retrace deepens beyond 0.65 of the impulse
events.conversion: Re-entry on resumption confirmation (pullback_resumed).

events.mechanism: Impulse resumes past its extreme after a healthy pullback - the move continues.
events.thesis: re-enter with the impulse; never re-enter a broken structure
events.invalidation: close back through the pullback low (bull) / high (bear)
events.conversion: Momentum re-entry under the resumption pivot.

events.mechanism: Structure anchor violated: the correction has become a reversal (the 'red after green' event).
events.thesis: stand out with profits banked - the impulse is over
events.invalidation: price reclaims the anchor within this candle
events.conversion: Exit/protection primitive; no fade until the opposite structure forms.

events.mechanism: After extended same-direction closes (3+ consecutive daily-ish candles) reversal base rates reach ~87-88% - mean reversion at the daily extreme.
events.thesis: prepare to protect/extract profits at streak extremes rather than chase
events.invalidation: streak extends (new high/low accepted by the market)
events.conversion: Profit-protection + re-entry-on-pullback trigger, not a blind reversal bet.

events.mechanism: Once extended >= k ATR in one session/leg, continuation base rates collapse and exhaustion/reversion odds rise.
events.machinery: MarketContext EXHAUSTION + momentum_extension guard (never add into EXHAUSTION).
events.thesis: do not add; protect gains already banked
events.conversion: Anti-waste guard on Momentum family; trail tightly.

principles: Context-conditional edges only: pattern/event alone is never a signal; confluence (level, trend, session, vol state) required.

Empirical calibration gate: every event carries an entering thesis; calibration tracks realized edge vs predicted; events that fail the baseline are downweighted. ~28% of naive pattern edges are notable, many opposite to textbook - never trust textbook.
Anti-event awareness: system tracks both thesis and anti-thesis; stays neutral when ambiguous (no wasted moves).
Structure mechanics > faded anomalies: liquidity/structure/volatility/momentum mechanics are preferred over calendar effects (mostly faded since 1980).

Deploy from history: never trust textbook base rates. Every probability the system quotes MUST be fit point-in-time on the instrument's own history (sequence_stats, depth percentiles, streak reversals) before it earns live weight.
Join, never fight: the system always asks 'what is the market doing right now' (regime/phase/bias) and trades WITH the current intent - never against it. Fighting the tape is how drawdown is born.
I5 / zero-alpha compliance: this catalog is DATA (schema) + machinery; concrete sizing/entry logic is system-written alpha (S2), gated by the Constitution.
